name: AI Search & Answer Engine Intelligence
definition: Software/services helping brands monitor, measure, or improve presence in AI-generated answers across LLMs and AI search surfaces.

name: AI Visibility Tracking
definition: Tools that query AI models with prompts and measure brand mention/citation frequency, position, and sentiment.

name: Native AI-Visibility Platforms
definition: Standalone companies built exclusively for AI-search visibility measurement (not modules of a broader SEO suite).

name: Suite-Embedded AI Visibility Modules
definition: AI visibility features bundled inside pre-existing SEO suites; not independently purchasable products.

name: AI Crawler & Technical Auditing
definition: Tools verifying AI-crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) and llms.txt validity.

name: GEO/AEO Content Optimization
definition: Tools scoring or generating content optimized for AI-answer extractability (answer nuggets, readability, briefs).

name: Search & SEO Intelligence
definition: Tools for search performance monitoring, rank tracking, technical SEO, and SEO suites.

name: Search Console (First-Party)
definition: Official first-party search performance tools operated directly by the search engine.

name: Search Console Data Enhancement
definition: Tools that import, extend, or enhance first-party GSC/Bing data (never replace it).

name: Rank Tracking
definition: Tools tracking keyword ranking positions across search engines.

name: SEO Suites
definition: Broad multi-feature platforms combining rank tracking, backlinks, site audit, and keyword research.

name: Technical SEO / Site Crawlers
definition: Desktop/cloud crawlers for technical SEO audits (broken links, redirects, indexation).

name: Schema Markup Tools
definition: Free/paid tools generating or validating JSON-LD structured data.

name: Web & Product Analytics
definition: Tools measuring website traffic (marketing) or in-product user behavior (product).

name: Web Analytics (First-Party)
definition: Official first-party web analytics platform (Google Analytics).

name: Privacy-First Web Analytics
definition: Cookie-free/GDPR-first web analytics positioned as GA4 alternatives, measuring marketing traffic.

name: Product Analytics
definition: Event-based behavioral analytics for in-product feature usage/retention; NOT a marketing-traffic (GA4) replacement.

name: Attribution, Account Intelligence & Buyer Journeys
definition: Tools connecting marketing/ad activity to CRM pipeline/revenue, and identifying anonymous account-level website visitors.

name: B2B Multi-Touch Attribution
definition: Platforms linking marketing touchpoints to CRM-recorded revenue outcomes.

name: ABM & Intent Data
definition: Predictive account scoring and intent-based orchestration platforms; distinct job from attribution reporting.

name: Visitor/Account Identification
definition: Tools de-anonymizing company- or person-level website visitors (dark-funnel intelligence).

name: CRM, Sales & Revenue
definition: Customer relationship management and revenue operations platforms.
